description: Health snapshot of the controller: uptime and last reset cause (watchdog?), main-loop speed and the longest stall, free RAM and its minimum, M4 button core, LAN link / WiFi, every network socket with its peer, outgoing HTTP slots, storage space, login brake counters. Due 3.12 gives a shorter set. raw=true = the JSON. Editor/admin level.
